name: PBC (Peripheral Blood Cells) Dataset
original_publication: Acevedo et al. 2020 Data in Brief
kaggle_mirror: UNKNOWN (multiple untraced mirrors exist; use official Mendeley link only)
notes: Primary classification backbone. Best license of all candidates.

name: Raabin-WBC
license: Free for commercial and non-commercial use (publisher statement, not SPDX-named)
notes: Primary detection/diversity source; only dataset with nucleus+cytoplasm masks at meaningful scale.

name: TXL-PBC (re-annotated integration)
notes: Primary whole-smear detection backbone. Re-uses images from BCCD/Raabin/PBC -- dedupe required before pooling with those sources.

name: KU-Optofil PBC Dataset
notes: Largest, most recent, best-annotated (Cohen kappa>0.85) source found. Do not use until license field is read directly from Zenodo record.

name: BCCD (Blood Cell Count and Detection)
notes: Original photos credited to 'cosmicad' and 'akshaylamba'. Cleanest license of detection sources.

name: Blood Cell Images (paultimothymooney)
license: Public-domain-style per Kaggle listing, attribution appreciated not required
notes: 12,500 images are augmentations of ~410 originals shared lineage with BCCD -- must not be treated as independent samples in any pooled count or leakage audit.

name: LISC (Leukocyte Images for Segmentation and Classification)
license: Research/education only. No redistribution. Must obtain directly from author. Mandatory acknowledgment.
notes: Imam Khomeini Hospital, Tehran. Usable only as a non-redistributed local benchmark with citation; excluded from pooled training/redistribution.

name: ALL-IDB (1 and 2)
original_publication: Labati Piuri Scotti 2011 IEEE ICIP (not PubMed-indexed)
license: Request-only; research use presumed; no public open license confirmed
notes: Requires direct email authorization from Fabio Scotti (Universita degli Studi di Milano). Not obtained -- excluded from v1.

name: C_NMC_2019 (ISBI 2019 ALL Challenge)
license: TCIA standard (CC BY 3.0/4.0 family -- confirm per-collection page)
notes: Not part of core 7-class v1 scope (leukemia classification is out of scope per spec's non-diagnostic positioning) but usable for later ALL-vs-normal research extension with real patient-level splits.

name: AML-Cytomorphology_LMU
original_publication: Matek et al. 2019 Nature Machine Intelligence
license: TCIA standard license family (typically CC BY 3.0 -- verify per collection)
classes: 15 classes incl. blasts and WBC subtypes
notes: Leukemia-patient population, not healthy donors. Valuable for future blast-detection extension; not in core v1 7-class scope.

name: LeukemiaAttri / LLD (Large Leukemia Dataset)
original_publication: Used in Diaz et al. 2026 Current Oncology
notes: Leukemia-patient population. Do not use until GitHub LICENSE file is read directly.

name: Chula-PIC-Lab (RBC morphology)
original_publication: Referenced only in Dhar et al. 2025 Microsc Res Tech
notes: No independently verifiable public access point located. Do not use. RBC morphology-subtype classification is NOT implemented in v1 as a result -- see feasibility audit sec 10.
